facts.fact: A steering committee of the Plan national stratégique Gabon digital 2025 (PNS-GD2025), meeting by videoconference with the African Development Bank, ANINF, the Prime Minister's office, the budget ministry and the government's general secretariat, is reported; the report does not describe the plan's scope. Date is the article's published date.

The article states the Gabon digital 2025 strategic plan is financed by the African Development Bank under project CAB Gabon through the Korea-Africa cooperation trust fund. Date is the article's published date.

systems.system: E-government master plan (plan directeur) of the PNS-GD2025
systems.tiers: inter-administration data exchange and administrative procedures; the steering committee 'validated' (validé) the master plan and strategic vision

note: What the committee validated is the e-government platform's master plan, a government-services instrument, so no standing fact is recorded for the PNS-GD2025, whose scope the article does not describe.
